identity.name: Meridian Advisory
identity.one_line_description: Meridian Advisory is a commercial property consultancy that connects businesses and investors with the right spaces through rigorous market analysis and expert guidance.
identity.target_audience: Business owners, corporate real estate directors, and institutional investors seeking commercial property acquisitions, disposals, or leasing in urban and suburban markets.

pages.title: Home

pages.meta_description: Meridian Advisory offers expert commercial property advisory services for investors and businesses. Explore listings, market insights, and connect with our specialist team.

sections.intent: Showcase the key commercial districts the firm covers, giving each a clear identity and relevant commercial metrics.
sections.headline: Key Commercial Districts We Cover

items.title: Central Business District
items.description: The city's primary office and financial hub. Home to headquarters of major corporations, law firms, and financial institutions. High demand, low vacancy, premium rents.

items.title: Portside Quarter
items.description: A regenerating waterfront zone attracting logistics, tech, and creative occupiers. Strong infrastructure investment and competitive rental terms.

items.title: North Quarter
items.description: Established retail and leisure corridor with consistent footfall. Anchored by major retail brands and well-served by public transport.

items.title: Elmswood Business Park
items.description: Purpose-built suburban campus offering modern, car-accessible office and light industrial space. Popular with mid-size businesses and regional HQs.

items.title: Creative Quarter
items.description: A converted industrial neighbourhood drawing design studios, media companies, and tech startups. Flexible space, vibrant street-level activity.

sections.intent: Convert location research into a direct advisory conversation, linking neighbourhood interest to a next step.
sections.headline: Let Our Advisors Guide Your Location Decision.
sections.subheadline: We combine market data with on-the-ground expertise to match your business with the district that serves it best.

sections.intent: Address the most common questions a prospective client has before making contact, reducing friction and building confidence.
sections.headline: Frequently Asked Questions

items.title: What types of commercial property do you advise on?
items.description: We advise across all commercial asset classes including Grade A and Grade B office, retail, industrial, logistics, mixed-use, and serviced office space.

items.title: Do you work with individual businesses or only institutional investors?
items.description: We work with both. Our client base ranges from growing SMEs seeking their first leased office to institutional funds managing multi-asset portfolios.

items.title: How quickly can an advisor respond to my enquiry?
items.description: All new enquiries receive an initial response within one business day. For urgent requirements, please call our offices directly.

items.title: Is there a fee for an initial consultation?
items.description: Initial consultations are complimentary. We will outline a proposed scope of work and fee structure following our first meeting.
